response.sql: WITH source_counts AS (SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) AS project_count FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), totals AS (SELECT AVG(project_count) AS average_count, SUM(project_count) AS total_count FROM source_counts) SELECT c.fundflux, c.project_count, 1.0 * c.project_count / t.total_count AS share, c.project_count - t.average_count AS above_average FROM source_counts AS c CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE c.project_count > t.average_count;

assumptions.assumption: A NULL fundflux is treated as one funding-source group.

alternatives.interpretation: Only projects with a known funding source count toward the results, average, and total.
alternatives.sql: WITH source_counts AS (SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) AS project_count FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref WHERE p.fundflux IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.fundflux), totals AS (SELECT AVG(project_count) AS average_count, SUM(project_count) AS total_count FROM source_counts) SELECT c.fundflux, c.project_count, 1.0 * c.project_count / t.total_count AS share, c.project_count - t.average_count AS above_average FROM source_counts AS c CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE c.project_count > t.average_count;
